pie: kʷís h₂nér túH? h₁eǵóh₂ toy dayh₂wḗr. h₂yúHn̥ḱa nos gʷḗn priHéh₂ h₁sdʰí. kúdʰe moy pótis h₁ésti? h₂éǵroy h₁ésti h₂érh₃yeti wékʷsperoy-kʷe nésētor. kénkoh₂ tr̥syóh₂-kʷe. sddʰí ḱód mḗms h₁ddʰí h₂mélǵos-kʷe ph₃dʰí. ǵénh₁trih₂ nos tébʰye tód pékʷet. méh₂tēr toy moy ḱéyweh₂.
english: Man, who are you? I am your husband's brother. Young woman, be dear to us! Where is my husband? He is in the field; he is ploughing, and he will come home in the evening. I am hungry and thirsty. Sit, eat this meat, and drink milk. Our mother cooked it for you. Your mother is dear to me.

pie: pótnih₂m dṓm h₂ewsér wédʰōh₂. h₂réh₁dʰe me. mógʰew ḱludʰí. swéḱurom toy mē dʰréwgʰs. h₁íh₂m̥ h₂lékse h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe mē stunéds. méh₂term̥ moy stunéds? h₁íh₂m̥ ne stunédm̥ h₁íh₂m̥ stérgom. h₁sn̥tyós wíHrōs deywóybʰos priHós. h₁sn̥tyós-ge wiHrós h₁ésoh₂.
english: At dawn I will lead a wife home. Counsel me. Listen, boy. Do not deceive your father-in-law. Protect her, and do not strike her. Did you strike my mother? I did not strike her; I cherished her. A true husband is dear to the gods. I will indeed be a true husband.

pie: dʰúgh₂ter wóǵʰos dʰwóri stestóh₂e. twós te pótis méneti. bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e stégos toy linékʷmi. kʷís toy péh₂wr̥ h₂Hséh₂i péh₂seti? méh₂tēr toy swésōr-kʷe tód péh₂setes. mē bʰéyh₂s. h₂ew te widṓh₂? h₁yód toy néwom dṓm h₁r̥sḱṓh₂ widḗsi me. ph₂ter kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. deywṓs te stóygʰoy h₂léksoyh₁ent.
english: Daughter, the wagon is standing at the door. Your husband is waiting for you. I am afraid; I am leaving your house. Who will guard the fire on your hearth? Your mother and your sister will guard it. Do not be afraid. Shall I see you again? When I come to your new house, you will see me. Be well, father! May the gods protect you on the road.

pie: méh₂ter h₂yuHn̥ḱéh₂m gʷénh₂m̥ wédʰōh₂. ph₂tḗr toy mért h₁eǵóh₂ h₁widʰéwh₂ h₂éHsh₂-kʷe góleti. séh₂ nos stégos gʷʰr̥néweti. kʷís séh₂? séh₂ h₁suménēs poh₂imnés dʰugh₂tḗr. h₁íh₂m̥ ǵn̥néh₃mi ḱubʰréh₂ wésmn̥h₂ téksti. h₁íh₂m̥ moy wédʰe h₁íh₂m̥ stérgōh₂. méh₂ter somHṓy ne h₁ésesi.
english: Mother, I will marry a young woman. Your father died; I am a widow, and the hearth is cold. She will warm our house. Who is she? She is Kindly, the shepherd's daughter. I know her; she weaves beautiful garments. Bring her to me; I will cherish her. You will not be alone, mother.

pie: swḗḱure péḱu h₁idʰé h₂éǵom. kʷóti h₂ówih₁ h₁sénti? déḱm̥ h₂óweyes kʷetwóres-kʷe ugʷsénes. h₁óynos ugʷsḗn sénos. só sénos wóǵʰom-kʷe déwkti. nu nos ph₂tḗr tetórpe. h₂ewsér bʰréh₂tr̥bʰis ḱóm gʷm̥dʰí swésorm̥-kʷe nos h₂epó wédʰe. h₂ewsér-ge gʷémoh₂.
english: Brother-in-law, I have driven the livestock here. How many sheep are there? Ten sheep and four oxen. One ox is old. He is old, and he pulls the wagon. Then our father is satisfied. Come at dawn with your brothers, and lead our sister away. I will indeed come at dawn.

pie: kʷíd toy h₂énHe ǵʰeséri bʰéresi? h₂énkuleh₂. méh₂tēr moy méǵʰye tā́m tékst. nu toy népti tā́m dédeh₃mi tā́m dh₂pnóy wéso. h₂éh₂usom h₁ésyeh₂i h₁épi h₁ésti. bʰréh₂tēr moy h₂éh₂usom déh₃t h₁ésyo stéh₂dʰh₁eh₂ méǵh₂h₂ h₁ést. tā́m h₂léksōh₂ dʰugh₂tréy-kʷe moy tā́m déh₃oh₂. nu moy toy h₁nómn̥ stégesi gʷíh₃wēti.
english: Grandmother, what are you carrying in your hand? A belt. My mother wove it for me. Now I give it to you, granddaughter; wear it at the feast. There is gold on it! My brother gave the gold; his herds were great. I will guard it and give it to my daughter. Then my name will live on in your house.

pie: h₂énHe wéyḱoh₂? h₂yúHn̥ḱa gʷḗn wiḱdʰí h₂Hséh₂s-kʷe nos h₁n̥gʷním gʷr̥nHdʰí. kʷíh₁ h₁ím gʷr̥néHoh₂? wr̥h₁dʰí. h₁ń̥gʷney ḱód stégos ph₂sdʰí téḱneh₂-kʷe nos dh₃dʰí. h₁ń̥gʷney ḱód stégos ph₂sdʰí téḱneh₂-kʷe nos dh₃dʰí. nu te h₁n̥gʷnís ǵn̥néh₃ti. ph₂wéni sddʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe.
english: Grandmother, shall I enter? Enter, young woman, and praise the fire of our hearth. How shall I praise him? Say: Fire, guard this house, and give us children! Fire, guard this house, and give us children! Now the fire knows you. Sit by the fire and eat.

pie: kʷís toy h₂éwh₂e ph₂tḗr h₁ést? só poh₂imḗn h₁ést só h₂nr̥ménēs h₁ést. wikét? póyḱons-ge próti wikét h₁éysōm-kʷe péḱu h₂epó h₁élh₂t. kʷís h₁ésyo ph₂tḗr h₁ést? h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ne wóydh₂e ǵérh₂ontes tód memnḗr. népot nos ǵénh₁os memn̥dʰí ǵn̥h₁méney-kʷe toy tód wéwke.
english: Grandfather, who was your father? He was a herdsman; he was Man-Minded. Did he fight? He did fight against enemies, and he drove off their livestock. And who was his father? I do not know his name; the old men remember it. Grandson, remember our lineage, and tell it to your offspring.

pie: tod ḱeḱruwos owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: bʰréh₂ter toy pótnih₂ twéd ḱéwbʰyōs. séh₂ ḱéwbʰyōs h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe ḱéwh₁yōs. séh₂ ǵnéh₃yōs. h₁ésyeh₂ey tód mē wérh₁s. h₁ésyeh₂ey tód dh₂pnóy wérh₁oh₂. nu poh₂imnés dʰugh₂tréy bʰéh₂oh₂. sékʷoh₂. bʰréh₂tēr moy te lubʰyéti. h₁ésyeh₂ey mē bʰéh₂s. nu th₂kéh₁yōwos.
english: Brother, your wife is prettier than you! She is prettier, and I am stronger. And she is wiser. Do not say that to her! I will say it to her at the feast. Then I will speak to the shepherd's daughter. I will say: My brother loves you. Do not speak to her! Then let us both keep silent.

pie: kʷíd moy bʰréh₂ter h₁éḱwom sléh₂gʷs? tóm ne sléh₂gʷm̥ ph₂tḗr nos méǵʰye tóm déh₃t. dʰrugʰyési me. ph₂tḗr moy tóm péruti déh₃t. bʰréh₂ter mē gʰrémes. mē wikṓwos. nu ph₂térm̥ préḱsowos. só ǵn̥h₃rós n̥smé h₁entér h₂réh₁dʰēti. nu tóm réydʰe h₁eǵóh₂-kʷe gʷṓs h₂éǵōh₂. bʰréh₂ter moy túH priHós.
english: Brother, why did you take my horse? I did not take him; our father gave him to me. You are deceiving me! Last year father gave him to me. Do not rage, brother. Let us two not fight. Let us ask father. He is wise; he will decide between us. Then you ride him, and I will drive the cattle. You are dear to me, brother.

pie: ǵḿ̥re moy h₃m̥nh₃dʰí. dʰugh₂térm̥ moy h₂léksēsi? diwéy ph₂tréy h₃m̥néh₃mi. h₁íh₂m̥ h₂léksōh₂ h₁íh₂m̥ ḱérh₃oh₂ h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe woséyōh₂. h₁yód h₁íh₂m̥ stunédesi h₁eǵóh₂ moy toy bʰréh₂teres-kʷe dʰwórm̥ gʷm̥yṓmes. h₁íh₂m̥ ne stunédoh₂ h₁íh₂m̥ lubʰyóh₂. nu h₁ésyeh₂s ǵʰésorm̥ h₁pdʰí. séh₂ twéh₂ pótnih₂.
english: Son-in-law, swear to me! Will you protect my daughter? I swear to Sky, the father: I will protect her, feed her and clothe her. If you strike her, my brothers and I will come to your door. I will not strike her; I love her. Then take her hand. She is your wife.

pie: owis, yesmin wl̥nā ne ēst, dedorḱe eḱwons wogʰom gʷr̥um wegʰontn̥s, bʰorom meǵHm, monum ōḱu bʰerontn̥s.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: kʷíd toy snúse ph₂trés démi dʰédʰeh₁s? h₂ówins h₂mélǵm̥ h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m léwh₃om mḗms-kʷe pékʷom. n̥sméy gʰostíbʰos-kʷe h₁idʰé pékʷēsi. kʷíd toy suHnús gʰr̥yéti? mḗms sweh₂dú-kʷe h₂élbʰit gʰr̥yéti. nu h₁ésmey téh₂ pékʷōh₂. snúse túH ǵn̥h₃réh₂. méh₂tēr moy h₁mé ḱéHst.
english: Daughter-in-law, what did you do in your father's house? I milked the sheep, I washed the wool, and I cooked meat. Here you will cook for us and for the guests. What does your son like? He likes meat and sweet barley. Then I will cook them for him. You are wise, daughter-in-law. My mother taught me.

pie: dʰúgh₂ter gʷegʷómth₂e. pótis toy tébʰye ḱéywos? só moy ḱéywos h₁ésyo-kʷe me ǵénh₁trih₂ wénHt. h₂én kénkesi? ne kénkoh₂ ǵr̥h₂nóm nos polh₁ú. méh₂ter moy téḱnom úderoy bʰuHyéti. mówdoysu. bʰréh₂teres toy mudrṓs h₁ésonti. tód suHnús h₁syéh₁t ḱuh₁rós-kʷe h₁syéh₁t. téḱnom-ge stérgōh₂.
english: Daughter, you have come! Is your husband dear to you? He is dear to me, and his mother has come to love me. Are you hungry there? I am not hungry; our grain is plentiful. Mother, a child is growing in my belly. Joy! Your brothers will be glad. May it be a son, and may it be strong! I will cherish the child.

pie: wĺ̥kʷoybʰos nos h₁óyneh₂m h₂ówim gʷʰént. kúdʰe h₁és? sés? dréwi Hn̥dʰí sésm̥. tód ne wéḱm̥. gʰrémoh₂ túH moy priHós. nu h₂ówins spéḱye mē-kʷe sés. nókʷtm̥ pér bʰéwdʰōh₂. ḱwónm̥ h₁áyso.
english: A wolf has killed one of our sheep! Where were you? Were you sleeping? I was sleeping under a tree. I did not want it. I am angry; but you are dear to me. Now watch the sheep, and do not sleep! I will stay awake through the night. Take the dog.

pie: pótey dinóm memónth₂e h₁mé dṓm h₁yósmi wédʰes? tóm-ge memónh₂e. ḱwitróm wésmn̥ wésth₂e bʰréh₂teres-kʷe toy nókʷtm̥ pér gʷéHyont. polh₁úh₂ yéh₁ōr gʷíh₃wowe. suHnéwes nos h₂uksént dʰugh₂téres-kʷe nos dweh₂róns ḱóymons litént. túH luǵrós? h₁eǵóh₂ ne luǵrós túH méǵʰye ḱóm h₁ési.
english: Husband, do you remember the day on which you led me home? I do remember it. You were wearing a white garment, and your brothers sang through the night. We two have lived many years. Our sons have grown up, and our daughters have gone away to distant villages. Are you sad? I am not sad; you are with me.

pie: h₂éwh₂e ugʷsénn̥s yéwgoh₂. kʷíh₁ h₁íns yéwgoh₂? népot yugóm bʰére tód-kʷe h₁éysōm kólsoysu h₁épi dʰh₁dʰí. ugʷsḗn me stunédti. mē bʰéyh₂s ǵʰésorm̥ toy ǵn̥néh₃ti. nu yugóm ugʷsn̥sú ḱéyor. h₁mé dedórḱth₂e? twé-ge dedórḱh₂e. népōts moy h₂wékst. h₁wésus poh₂imḗn h₁ésesi.
english: Grandfather, let me yoke the oxen. How shall I yoke them? Bring the yoke, grandson, and set it on their necks. The ox is pushing me! Do not be afraid; he knows your hand. Now the yoke lies on the oxen. Have you seen me? I have indeed seen you. My grandson has grown up! You will be a good herdsman.

pie: kúdʰe toy pótey dṓm h₁ésti? só déh₂nu éti péruni Hn̥dʰí h₁ésti. déh₂nu dʰubʰróm? tód dʰubʰróm ugʷsénes nos wódr̥ pér wéǵʰōnti. wédn̥s dedwóyh₂e. ǵʰésorm̥ moy kapyé. h₁yód h₁ludʰṓwos méh₂tēr moy toy pódh₁e léwh₃ēti. kʷíd toy ph₂tḗr dʰédʰeh₁eti? h₂Hséh₂i te sodéyēti dóh₃r̥-kʷe toy déh₃eti.
english: Husband, where is your house? It is beyond the river, below the mountain. Is the river deep? It is deep, but the oxen will carry us through the water. I am afraid of the water. Hold my hand. When we two arrive, my mother will wash your feet. What will your father do? He will seat you at the hearth and give you a gift.

pie: kúdʰe moy ph₂ter méh₂term̥ ǵnéh₃s? séh₂ wódr̥ bʰr̥h₁wéni h₁épi bʰéret smḗyt-kʷe. kʷíd smḗyt? wódr̥ h₁n̥dó séngʷm̥. túH wódr̥ h₁n̥dó séngʷs? séngʷm̥-ge séh₂-kʷe me h₁éǵʰs déwkt. h₁íh₂m̥ tósmi dinóy wénHm̥. twé wénHt? h₁íh₂m̥ préḱsdʰi.
english: Father, where did you meet my mother? At the spring: she was carrying water, and she laughed. Why did she laugh? I fell into the water. You fell into the water? I did fall, and she pulled me out. On that day I came to love her. Did she come to love you? Ask her!

pie: bʰréh₂ter nos ph₂tḗr mért. kʷíh₁ h₁ésyo péḱu bʰéh₂gōwos? tód dwís bʰéh₂gōwos. h₁éḱwons h₁áyso h₁eǵóh₂ péḱu h₁áyoh₂er. h₁éḱwōs péh₂urōs péḱu polh₁ú. h₁éḱwōs pḱéws HéHḱyoses. HeHḱéwes h₁éḱwōs h₂mélǵos ne dédh₃n̥ti. h₁sónt bʰéh₂si. nu dwóh₁ gʷówh₁e h₁áyso. nu deywṓs méwdōnti.
english: Brother, our father has died. How shall we two divide his livestock? Let us divide it in two. You take the horses; I will take the cattle. The horses are few; the cattle are many. But the horses are swifter than the cattle. Swift horses do not give milk! You speak the truth. Then take two cows. Now the gods will be glad.

pie: kʷíd gʷḗn tewh₂téh₂ stóygʰoy gʷéHyeti? suHnús moy h₃rēǵés dʰugh₂térm̥ wédʰeti. spéḱye. wóǵʰos gʷm̥sḱéti dwóh₁-kʷe albʰóh₁ ugʷsénh₁e tóm duktés. kúdʰe h₂éǵmn̥ h₁éyti? wóyḱom nos h₁éyti. pékʷtōr nos mḗms h₂én pékʷeti. gʰóstey n̥sméy ḱóm gʷm̥dʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe. gʷémoh₂ h₃rēǵés-kʷe dʰugh₂térm̥ gʷr̥néHoh₂. priHós nos h₁sdʰí.
english: Woman, why are the people singing on the road? My son is marrying the king's daughter. Look! The wagon is coming, and two white oxen are drawing it. Where is the procession going? It is going to our settlement. There our cook is cooking meat. Guest, come with us and eat! I will come, and I will praise the king's daughter. Be dear to us!

pie: swésor moy h₂yuHn̥ḱós mógʰus h₂énkuleh₂m déh₃t. kʷís tā́m déh₃t? h₁suh₁éḱwos poh₂imnés mógʰus. h₁eǵóh₂ twéd sényōs. sényōs pr̥h₂wéh₂. nu h₂nérm̥ moḱs h₂isḱé. tóm dʰǵʰyés widóm poh₂imnés bʰréh₂term̥. nu somHóy dinóy wédʰōwosdʰh₂. deywṓs nos h₁wésuns wiHróns dh₃ih₁ént.
english: Sister, a young man gave me a belt. Who gave it? Of-Good-Horses, the shepherd's boy. I am older than you! The older one is the first. Then seek a man quickly! I found one yesterday: the shepherd's brother. Then we two will be married on the same day. May the gods give us good husbands.

pie: swésor nos méh₂tr̥s péh₃tlom Hrunépm̥. bʰréh₂ter séh₂ gʰrémēti. h₁ésyeh₂ey mē wéwkes. ǵénh₁trih₂m nos ne dʰrugʰyṓh₂. h₁íh₂m̥ gʷh₂dʰí ḱód-kʷe wr̥h₁dʰí. tód ne wéḱm̥. méǵʰye ḱóm gʷémesi? gʷémoh₂-ge h₁ésyeh₂ey-kʷe bʰéh₂oh₂. túH moy ḱéyweh₂.
english: Sister, I broke our mother's cup. Brother, she will be angry! Do not tell her! I will not deceive our mother. Go to her and say this: I did not want it. Will you come with me? I will come, and I will speak to her. You are dear to me.

pie: nu h₃réḱs pótnih₂ súHnum ǵeǵonh₁e.
english: The king's lady bore a son.

pie: h₂énHe moy wéwke. kʷíh₁ moy h₂éwh₂os twé wédʰet? ph₂trés moy sédos déḱm̥ h₁éḱwōys ḱóm h₁ludʰét. ǵérh₂onts smḗyt tóns-kʷe sléh₂gʷt. túH bʰéyh₂s? ne bʰéyh₂m̥ h₁ím wénHm̥. kʷím-kʷe népti túH wélh₁esi? ne wóydh₂e. h₂énHe moy wl̥h₁dʰí. nu wiHróm wélh₁oh₂ h₁yós sweh₂dúh₂ kéh₂nmn̥h₂ gʷéHyeti.
english: Grandmother, tell me: how did my grandfather marry you? He arrived at my father's dwelling with ten horses. The old man laughed and took them. Did you become afraid? I did not become afraid; I came to love him. And you, granddaughter, whom will you choose? I do not know. You choose for me, grandmother! Then I will choose a man who sings sweet songs.

pie: bʰréh₂ter moy néwos dṓm dweh₂rós. wĺ̥kʷōs péruni h₁sénti. h₁mé péh₂sesi? péh₂soh₂-ge te ǵʰoysóm moy sléh₂gʷoh₂. ḱwṓ-kʷe moy wóǵʰoy h₂énti drémeti. túH h₁sn̥tyós bʰréh₂tēr. h₁yód toy suHnús ǵn̥h₁yḗtor h₁ésmey pṓlHom bʰérōh₂. nu swóm h₂éwh₂om stérgēti. h₁ím-ge pṓlHoy dʰéh₁oh₂.
english: Brother, my new house is far away. There are wolves on the mountain. Will you guard me? I will guard you; I will take my spear. And my dog will run in front of the wagon. You are a true brother. When your son is born, I will bring him a foal. Then he will cherish his uncle. I will indeed set him on the foal.

pie: népti te wiHrós prḗḱst. kʷís h₂éwh₂e só? só h₁sn̥tyóḱlewēs h₁ésyo ḱléwos h₁wésu. ph₂tḗr moy méh₂tēr-kʷe mr̥tā́m. kʷís h₁ésmey h₁mé h₁opéyēti? h₁eǵóh₂ te h₁opéyōh₂ h₁eǵóh₂ toy ǵn̥h₁tryéh₂s bʰréh₂tēr. kʷís h₁wédmn̥ h₁áyetor? túH tód h₁áyeth₂er tód twóm h₁éseti. deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént.
english: Niece, a man has asked for you. Uncle, who is he? He is Of-True-Fame; his fame is good. My father and mother have died. Who will give me to him? I will give you; I am your mother's brother. Who will receive the bride price? You will receive it; it will be yours. May the gods give you good things.
